name: Chief Hawkwind
summary: At Camp Narache, Chief Hawkwind prepares young Shu'halo for the wider world. He guides their traditional rites of passage on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore, teaching humility, respect for the land, and the strength to protect their people.

sections.title: Chieftain of the Mesa
sections.body: Chief Hawkwind prepares young tauren at Camp Narache for life beyond Red Cloud Mesa. On the mesa, fledgling hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors undertake the ancient Rites of the Earthmother. Hawkwind oversees the customs, teaching each youth duty and endurance before they leave the mesa's safety.

sections.title: Guiding the Rites
sections.body: Chief Hawkwind begins his lessons with humility, not martial glory. He sends initiates to fetch clean spring water and do other simple chores, teaching reverence for nature and their elders. Once they show humility, braves face tests of martial prowess. Their trials test their resolve against aggressive Bristleback quilboar encroaching on the ancestral plains.

sections.title: Defending Camp Narache
sections.body: Chief Hawkwind must also face dangers at Camp Narache's doorstep. The Bristleback tribe presses against Red Cloud Mesa's perimeter with growing boldness. Hawkwind coordinates the settlement's defense, sending newly proven braves to blunt quilboar assaults and keep the sacred training grounds secure.

aliases: who is the chief at camp narache
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind leads Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. He oversees tribal matters there and mentors young tauren preparing to enter the wider world of Mulgore and Kalimdor.

faq.q: What are the Rites of the Earthmother?
faq.answer: The Rites of the Earthmother are sacred trials that young tauren undertake as they come of age. Elders such as Chief Hawkwind guide the rites, which test humility, strength, courage, and spiritual ties to the land and ancestors.

faq.q: Why does Chief Hawkwind have you fetch water first?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind gives you the task of fetching water to teach that service and respect for the community matter as much as martial strength. Gathering fresh water for tribal elders teaches patience and humility before initiates face battle.

faq.q: What threat is Camp Narache facing?
faq.answer: Hostile Bristleback quilboar from the hills around Red Cloud Mesa keep pressure on Camp Narache. Chief Hawkwind organizes the mesa's defense and sends initiates to thin their ranks.

faq.q: Where does Chief Hawkwind send adventurers next?
aliases: where do i go after hawkwind
faq.answer: After a young brave completes the preliminary rites on the mesa, Chief Hawkwind sends them down into Mulgore's valleys. They go to Bloodhoof Village to find Chief Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne, and continue the Rites of the Earthmother.

faq.q: Is Chief Hawkwind related to Greatmother Hawkwind?
faq.answer: Yes. Greatmother Hawkwind is Chief Hawkwind's mother. Their family has deep roots and a long history of leadership among the tauren of Red Cloud Mesa.

angles.text: As a tauren, you learn the Shu'halo's first values from Chief Hawkwind: reverence for the Earthmother, loyalty to your tribe, and humility in strength.
As a member of the Horde, you join newly raised tauren braves shaped by Hawkwind's teachings into capable warriors and spellcasters, and steadfast, honorable allies.
